purpose: Test a distinct per-query selective-risk controller on new public independent queries, without changing neural weights or lowering the80% floor. Preserve all campaign08 case-any-error failures.
justification: Product decisions answer one exact proposition. A case-any-error bound for2-4 correlated contrastive questions targets a different and stricter loss than per-question risk. Do not silently substitute estimands or claim results for the old pair-weighted distribution.
population: Uniform unused components, one complete revision case selected, then one hash-selected query per case, seed1922. Conditional human evidence labels, not current-world truth. Calibration/test exclude all previously selected components and observed FEVER page/claim/span components.
data: 1000 new independent calibration-fit queries and1000 independent risk queries from unused official training components (never gradient-trained).207 reused validation queries for map/model selection.600 new locked queries from unused official test components; full locked case pairs retained separately.
models: Original/frozen head; prior FEVER encoder/frozen head; mixed-data parent/frozen head; parent/replay-mixture head; continued encoder/mixture head. Fixed weights and head files, no training on these cohorts.
gate: Fit correctness maps on fit only; select mapping by reused validation Brier. One-sided exact binomial risk bound on independent selected queries, Bonferroni alpha=.05/5, minimum30 accepted. Minimum mapped correctness80%; CP bound>=80%. Calibrated confidence remains a score, not a guarantee for each answer or arbitrary shift.
selection: Freeze strongest qualified configuration by validation correct-definitive fraction, raw accuracy and complete-population quality, before any new locked predictions. Report all frozen systems honestly, no post-hoc winner selection on locked data.
claims: Separate per-query population results, all-pair case robustness diagnostics, and live Gemini workflows. No Gemini cost/latency advantage, production release, new cloud spend or public redistribution inferred.
stopping: Complete both trained checkpoints, controls, independent calibration and locked evaluation if qualified. Continue optimization only from measured failures with unused evidence and declared new experiments. No perfect/global-optimum claim.
